name: 6E London-to-NY Handoff: Extension vs Reversal
description: Analyzes EUR/USD (EURUSD-FX proxy for 6E) behavior at the London-to-NY session handoff on 1-min bars. London session: 03:00-08:00 ET, NY session: 08:00-12:00 ET. Computes London session range each day, flags "wide London" days (≥75th percentile rolling), and classifies NY behavior as extension (NY breaks beyond London high/low) or reversal (NY stays inside London range). Output: summary table with extension/reversal rates by day type + scatter plot of London range vs NY extension magnitude.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EUR/USD LONDON-TO-NY HANDOFF: EXTENSION vs REVERSAL (1-Min)
# =============================================================================
# London session: 03:00-08:00 ET | NY session: 08:00-12:00 ET
# Extension = NY breaks beyond London high or low
# Reversal  = NY stays entirely within London range
# "Wide London" = London range ≥ 75th percentile (rolling)
# Uses EURUSD-FX as proxy for 6E futures (same price, same pip structure)
# =============================================================================

# === DATA ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === LONDON SESSION (03:00-08:00 ET) ===
ldn = session_window(session=Session(start='03:00', end='08:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
ldn_h = ffill_day(ldn.high)
ldn_l = ffill_day(ldn.low)

# === NY SESSION (08:00-12:00 ET) ===
ny = session_window(session=Session(start='08:00', end='12:00', tz='America/New_York'))(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c)
is_ny_close = ny.closed

# End-of-NY filter: 1.0 at NY close, NaN elsewhere
eod_raw = 1.0 if is_ny_close else 0.0 / 0.0
eod = eod_raw / eod_raw

# === LONDON RANGE (pips, 1 pip = 0.0001) ===
ldn_range_live = (ldn_h - ldn_l) * 10000.0
ldn_range = ldn_range_live * eod

# === WIDE/NARROW LONDON FLAG ===
# percentrank over ~140 trading days of 1-min bars (FX ~1380 bars/day)
ldn_pctrank = percentrank(period=200000)(ldn_range_live)
ldn_pctrank_eod = ldn_pctrank * eod
is_wide = ldn_pctrank_eod >= 75.0
is_narrow = ldn_pctrank_eod < 25.0

# === NY EXTENSION METRICS (at NY close only) ===
# Positive = NY exceeded London boundary; Negative = NY stayed inside
upside_ext = (ny.high - ldn_h) * 10000.0 * eod
downside_ext = (ldn_l - ny.low) * 10000.0 * eod

# Binary classification
is_ext = (upside_ext > 0) or (downside_ext > 0)
ext_flag = 1.0 if is_ext else 0.0
rev_flag = 1.0 - ext_flag

# Max extension: the larger breakout side (positive on ext days, ≤0 on rev days)
max_ext = upside_ext if upside_ext >= downside_ext else downside_ext

# Signed net extension for scatter (positive = net upside, negative = net downside)
net_ext = upside_ext - downside_ext

# === FILTERED SERIES FOR TABLE ===

# All days
all_ext_pips = where(is_ext, max_ext)
all_rev_dist = where(not is_ext, 0.0 - max_ext)

# Wide London days
wide_ext_flag = where(is_wide, ext_flag)
wide_rev_flag = where(is_wide, rev_flag)
wide_ext_pips = where(is_wide and is_ext, max_ext)
wide_rev_dist = where(is_wide and (not is_ext), 0.0 - max_ext)
wide_marker = where(is_wide, 1.0)

# Narrow London days
narrow_ext_flag = where(is_narrow, ext_flag)
narrow_rev_flag = where(is_narrow, rev_flag)
narrow_ext_pips = where(is_narrow and is_ext, max_ext)
narrow_rev_dist = where(is_narrow and (not is_ext), 0.0 - max_ext)
narrow_marker = where(is_narrow, 1.0)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: Extension vs Reversal Stats ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='London-to-NY Handoff: Extension vs Reversal',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['All Days', 'Wide London (≥75th pct)', 'Narrow London (<25th pct)'],
        col_headers=['Extension Rate', 'Reversal Rate', 'Avg Extension (pips)', 'Avg Reversal Dist (pips)', 'Day Count'],
        cells=[
            # Row 0: All Days
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 1: Wide London
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            # Row 2: Narrow London
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='Handoff Analysis',
    order=0
)(
    ext_flag, rev_flag, all_ext_pips, all_rev_dist, ext_flag,
    wide_ext_flag, wide_rev_flag, wide_ext_pips, wide_rev_dist, wide_marker,
    narrow_ext_flag, narrow_rev_flag, narrow_ext_pips, narrow_rev_dist, narrow_marker
)

# --- Scatter: London Range vs NY Extension ---
xy_scatter(
    title='London Range Width vs NY Extension Magnitude',
    x_axis_label='London Session Range (pips)',
    y_axis_label='NY Net Extension (pips, + = upside, - = downside)',
    category='Handoff Analysis',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=0,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name="NY Extension", color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title="Zero (No Net Extension)", color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(x=ldn_range, y_values=(net_ext,))
